why: Chronicle: a Goals section on the item's page, a sheet (kind, target typed, Per chips), a bar under the headline; no glance in the app
Timety: one daily focus goal for all time (Settings, a Home card), milestones on their own screen updated by hand; no goal per activity or tracker
Streak: a goal inside a habit's form (Amount, Time, steppers), Today's card with a bar, a percent and a flame streak; no milestones
aTimeLogger: a Goals tab, a form with three wheels (hours, minutes, period), notified when reached; no trackers
Loop: a measurable habit's typed target and frequency, the day cells show the value; no milestones
